notes.title: Limsod v1.3.0
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone!

We are very excited to present the third content update for Limsod!
In this update, mainly the switch to one of the latest versions of the unreal engine (which changes a lot of things inside the game). Also a new map for the Unlimited game mode, as well as new quests and achievements, improved quality of life and many other little things!

Also, a demo of Limsod will be available for free on Steam![/b]

[b][u]Here is a detailed list of what we have been working on:[/u][/b]


  [h5][b]Switch to unreal engine 5.4, which means:[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Several texture enhancements
[*]Improved zombie AIs
[*]Improved LODs
[*]Improved lightings
[*]Improved shadows
[*]Optimization of light sources
[*]Performance stabilization
[/list]

  [h5][b]Additions:[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Added map for Unlimited game mode: Cargo
[*]Added interactive objects on all maps
[*]Added seasonal events
[*]Added total controller support
[*]Added discord rich presence
[*]Added a button to skip the tutorial
[*]Added a button for replaying the tutorial (in the game mode menu)
[*]Added 3 new achievements
[*]Added 3 new normal quests (use 25, 75, 150 grenades)
[*]Added a new ambience sound for explosive zombie
[*]Added new lights in the room at the back of the Training game mode map
[*]Added 6 new icons
[/list]

  [h5][b]Changes:[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Modification of crosshair
[*]Modification of several menu visuals
[*]Modification of the Steam link in the pause menu
[*]Modification of controller icons
[*]Modification of the information menu
[*]Modification of the legal menu
[/list]

  [h5][b]Corrections:[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Fixed of random background musics in-game
[*]Fixed timer that did not start with game modes: Time Saving, Melee, Custom
[*]Fixed player sprint speed
[*]Fixed the player custom sprint speed (with Custom game mode)
[*]Fixed zombies that were already spawned on the jungle map (Defense game mode)
[*]Fixed zombies in Defense game mode that didn't move.
[*]Fixed zombie trajectory on Defense game mode maps
[*]Fixed several translation problems
[/list]


[u][b]Check out our other games and get them with a discount:[/b][/u]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41388/Limsod_Games_Collection/


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2555030/Limsod

notes.title: Limsod v1.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone!

We are very excited to present the second content update for Limsod!
This content update focuses mainly on the addition of new weapon upgrades as well as several other small additions and modifications.[/b]

[b][u]Here is a detailed list of what we have been working on:[/u][/b]

  [h5][b]Additions:[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Added weapon upgrade: Icon
[*]Added weapon upgrade: Full Auto
[*]Added weapon upgrade: Compensator
[*]Added weapon upgrade: Sniper Scope
[*]Added fire rate statistics in weapon customization
[*]Added game customization setting: max ammo 0, 1000
[*]Added game customization setting: grenade 5s
[*]Added game customization setting: max health 200, 500, 1000
[*]Added game customization setting: stamina 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 5x
[*]Added HUD indication of the number of kills remaining before moving on to a new round in Death Sleeves game mode
[*]Added a heal box in each room of rounds 25, 50, 75, 100 of Death Sleeves maps
[*]Defense game mode: the healer zombie now regenerates 5HP on the antenna if detected within its radius.
[*]Added a line on the ground indicating the detection radius of the antenna in Defense game mode
[*]Added new ambient particles to maps
[*]Added option for mouse sensitivity during aiming
[*]Added 15 new daily quests:
[olist]
[*]  Play on Survival game mode
[*]  Play on Points Race game mode
[*]  Play on Time Saving game mode
[*]  Play on Melee game mode
[*]  Play on Training game mode
[*]  Play on Preview game mode
[*]  Play on Custom game mode
[*]  Kill 750 zombies
[*]  Kill 250 zombies
[*]  Play 5 games
[*]  Kill 10 zombies explosive
[*]  Kill 30 zombies training
[*]  Kill 20 zombies sprinter
[*]  Kill 5 zombies armored
[*]  Use 5 heal boxes
[/olist]
[/list]
  [h5][b]Changes:[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Modification of the level required to unlock the Suppressor weapon upgrade: lvl20 ➔ lvl15
[*]Modification of the level required to unlock the Flash Light weapon upgrade: lvl35 ➔ lvl30
[*]Modification of the level required to unlock the Laser weapon upgrade: lvl60 ➔ lvl65
[*]Modification of the grip model
[*]Modification of custom weapon menu
[*]Modification of skill point distribution: 2 ➔ 3
[*]Modification of rewards information in the Level Rewards menu
[*]Modification of crosshair behavior in certain cases
[*]Improved visual animations of the Defense game mode antenna
[*]Modification of some Training map objects
[*]Modification of some door data in the Death Sleeves Office map
[*]Rebalancing ammunition distributed with the Death Sleeves game mode
[*]Modification of brute zombie animation when rotating
[*]Modification of healer zombie and toxic zombie hit blood sound
[*]Enhanced several textures
[*]Updating the Legal menu
[*]Updating the Information menu
[/list]

  [h5][b]Corrections:[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Fixed some text font problems with the Portuguese language
[*]Fixed several texts not translated
[*]Fixed the sound of the suppressor upgrade, which remained active when removed
[*]Fixed playtime statistics (in some situations the value was reset to 0)
[*]Fixed Upgrade Weapon menu construct animation
[*]Fixed some flying tree trunks on the dry mountain map
[*]Fixed a problem with terrain generation in the tutorial map
[/list]

  [h5][b]Optimizations:[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Optimization of the Defense game mode antenna
[*]Optimization of quests menus
[*]Optimization of multiple particles
[*]Optimization of multiple decals
[*]Optimization of game modes menu
[*]Optimization of dry mountain map foliage
[*]Defense zombies optimization
[/list]

Cubin, a first-person platform puzzle game that immerses you in the LGA experience. Complete 60 experiments to discover the truth about this simulation.[/b]
[b][h5]Add Cubin to your wishlist to support us![/h5][/b]

notes.title: Limsod v1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone!

A big thank you to everyone for supporting the game! Thanks to your feedback (and to the content creators) we've found several things to improve the game to make it more understandable for new players. In particular, we've implemented a tutorial at first launch to introduce the game's basic functions.
Here is a list of what we have been working on:[/b]


  [h5][b]Additions:[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Added tutorial on first game launch
[*]Added a new achievement
[*]Added text on doors to indicate which sleeve opens (game mode Death Sleeves)
[*]Added a new "Controller" category to controls
[*]Added option: controller sensitivity (camera)
[*]Added option: controller sensitivity (aim)
[*]Added option: controller vibrations
[*]Added vibration for controllers
[*]Added a new animation when there's no ammunition left in the weapon's magazine
[*]Added text to map selection
[*]Added error message when using a heal box with full life
[*]Added sizzling lights on the Factory map
[/list]

  [h5][b]Changes:[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Modification of starting ammunition in Death Sleeves game mode (100 ➔ 150)
[*]Modification of the Death Sleeves game mode description
[*]Modification of the ammunition distribution with the Death Sleeves game mode: From now on, you no longer earn ammunition by passing sleeves, but zombies drop ammunition on their dead.
[*]Modification of daily quest: Kill 5 zombie healers (5 ➔ 3)
[*]Modification of daily quest reward xp (2500 ➔ 1500)
[*]Modification of xp required to pass level 2 (500 ➔ 1000)
[*]Modification of xp buffer to reach next level (1.054882 ➔ 1.05)
[*]Modification of the log system
[*]Modification of game time with Melee game mode (5min ➔ 2min)
[*]Modification of weapon reload speed (without upgrade): (2.7s ➔ 2s)
[*]Modification of Factory map brightness
[*]Modification of Dark Forest map brightness
[*]Modification of Mountain map brightness
[*]Modification of Dry Mountain map brightness
[*]Increased detection zone for ammunition box pickup
[*]Increased number of bullets in ammunition boxes
[*]Reorganization of maps in alphabetical order
[*]Reorganization of controls
[*]Updating the information menu
[/list]

  [h5][b]Corrections / Optimizations:[/b][/h5]
[list]
[*]Fixed zombie kills that counted if the antenna killed a zombie (game mode Defense)
[*]Fixed some decals that were not rendered on certain maps
[*]Fixed harmless zombie training against melee
[*]Fixed menu controls and languages in game that unpause and remove the cursor
[*]Fixed several places on the maps where you could be invincible to zombies
[*]Fixed several translation errors
[*]Game optimization
[/list]
